searchText: question on the t8n tests in retesteth: did we change the key in the env.json from `beaconRoot` to `parentBeaconBlockRoot` and if so where is the place upstream that standardizes on it? it's an easy fix, I just want to make sure it's not gonna break other env.jsons https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/issues/6092 probably for <@393119312350543872> I think this one is my fault, I remember changing it to match geth, but it also made sense to me back then because this is the name used in the EIP (it uses `parent_beacon_block_root`) Yes it was changed around 2 months ago to match geth t8n, pyspec and eip interesting, where should I be looking for an upstream commit that made that change, i didn't see it in retesteth It might only be visible in the fixtures, not in retesteth itself. Here's thee commit that effects test fixtures generated by execution-spec-tests: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/commit/9191b956f23f0974b96bcfbaee42787d7e4c2b07 ok, then I'm not gonna feel bad about not having any test coverage on this Hopefully, these days, we'd add that to the breaking changes in our fixture release notes here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases

excerpts.author: robocopsgonemad
excerpts.content: question on the t8n tests in retesteth: did we change the key in the env.json from `beaconRoot` to `parentBeaconBlockRoot` and if so where is the place upstream that standardizes on it? it's an easy fix, I just want to make sure it's not gonna break other env.jsons

excerpts.content: I think this one is my fault, I remember changing it to match geth, but it also made sense to me back then because this is the name used in the EIP (it uses `parent_beacon_block_root`)
